description: This file defines the BuzzController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the Buzz plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes traits for authentication and employee services. The main function preRender prepares a Vue component with employee data to be rendered.

classes.name: BuzzController
classes.description: Controller for the Buzz plugin, handling the preparation of Vue components with employee data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with the current employee's data before rendering.
